kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Accounting provision to absorb estimated credit losses over the life of the assets
kpis.description: Reserve maintained by management to be sufficient to absorb estimated credit losses. Its calculation is based on periodic assessments, historical experience, current conditions, and reasonable and supportable economic forecasts. Key factors: expected probabilities of default, loss given default, economic forecasts for unemployment in Ohio, Ohio GDP, and the Ohio housing price index.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.
